paragraph: Maywood is a single-family market and a real seller's market right now. Twenty-six homes sold over six months at a median of $750,000, the sale-to-list ratio is 1.04, and 96 percent of sales closed above asking with a median of 14 days on market. Sellers are dictating terms here, and buyers should expect competition on the good ones. The typical sale is a three-bedroom colonial or cape with two full baths, which is what keeps the median where it is. Sales ran from $600,000 to $1,250,000, so anchor on the median rather than the range. Monthly counts are too thin to read a price trend month to month, but closing volume built into July the way it usually does. If Maywood follows the normal seasonal arc, expect the pace to cool modestly through fall.
